note: Verification certificate for a published worked example of the straddling checkerboard (Wikipedia: board with header ETAONRIS, blank columns 2 and 6, rows BCDFGHJKLM and PQ/UVWXYZ., printed sentence "ATTACK AT DAWN", ciphertext 3113212731223655). Spaces are not encoded, so the recovered plaintext is ATTACKATDAWN. Known-cipher solver only. Not an unknown-script reading. Not a reading of Linear A, Indus, Voynich, rongorongo, Kryptos K4, or army message Nr. 86.
